title: GroupCreate
description: Properties required when creating a new group.

displayName.description: The display name for the group.

groupTypes.description: Set to ["Unified"] for Microsoft 365 groups. Omit for security groups.

members@odata.bind.description: List of directory object URLs to add as members. Example: https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/directoryObjects/{id}

owners@odata.bind.description: List of directory object URLs to set as owners.
